items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I came back home, and I formed a band with Red Callender, Bumps Myers, Paul Campbell Gamel was trumpet

ctx.x: An interesting thing that one of the acts that worked with us at Cafe Society was the woman that made -- what was it, a "Star is Born"? Judy HolXiday?

Judy HolXiday was one of the acts in the show. I was trying to think of the name of the act -- they had the craziest acts in the world. You know, the Cafe Society would always be Meade Lux. Lewis, Pete Johnson, and some little new act, and then the band, which was us, you know.

And Judy HolXiday had an act -- something about the shoe, you know? And I have a picture of her in that -- but didn't realize until after I saw it in motion pictures, you know -- well Red Callender was the one that told me who it was at the time, and so we went back and looked at the pictures, and it was her.

items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: At that time, I was working with Lee in Lester's band... Red Norvo was on that, and Mel Powell on piano, Lee Young on drums, and myself

ctx.x: Blanton and I became friends. As a matter of fact, when Blanton got sick... Well, we were good friends. I was with him the day before he died. Lee Young and I and Billy Strayhorn; you know, we used to hang out together. At that time, I was working with Lee in Lester's band... I'm jumping around, but that's the way it comes.

And as you said, Marshall was in it, Marvin Johnson ...
